close_reason: Implemented /.well-known/mta-sts.txt handler in sieve_admin.rs. Route is outside bearer-token layer. Extracts domain from Host header, matches config.mta_sts.hosted_domains, returns RFC 8461 §3.2 body. 6 unit tests added.
description: stoa-2xeks.10 (Serve /.well-known/mta-sts.txt via axum) is marked closed but no handler exists anywhere in the codebase. sieve_admin.rs serves /admin/sieve/* and /metrics only. main.rs starts no additional HTTP server for this endpoint. MtaStsConfig::hosted_domains config is parsed but never served. Phase 1 of MTA-STS (publish policy for hosted domains) is entirely unimplemented.
title: /.well-known/mta-sts.txt handler absent despite issue stoa-2xeks.10 closed
